```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using OpenCvSharp;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine.Networking;
using System.Collections;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Enhanced OpenCV-based face recognizer that uses the ArcFace embeddings
    /// generated on PC for training, and uses improved OpenCV features for live recognition.
    /// 
    /// This is the implementation of yesterday's breakthrough idea:
    /// - Use ArcFace on PC to get high-quality training embeddings
    /// - Use lightweight OpenCV features on device for live recognition
    /// - Compare using cosine similarity
    /// 
    /// No heavy models needed on device!
    /// </summary>
    public class EnhancedOpenCVRecognizer : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Settings")]
        [Tooltip("Path to pre-computed ArcFace embeddings")]
        public string embeddingsFilePath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Tooltip("Similarity threshold (0.0-1.0, higher = stricter)")]
        [Range(0.0f, 1.0f)]
        public float similarityThreshold = 0.35f; // Lower for enhanced features
        
        [Tooltip("Names to show as 'Unknown' even when recognized")]
        public List<string> anonymousNames = new List<string> { "Obama", "Jshlatt", "ScarlettJohansson" };
        
        [Tooltip("Enable debug logging")]
        public bool enableDebugLogging = true;
        
        [Tooltip("Feature extraction method")]
        public FeatureExtractionMethod featureMethod = FeatureExtractionMethod.MultiScale;

        public enum FeatureExtractionMethod
        {
            MultiScale,     // Best: combines multiple feature types
            HOG,           // Histogram of Oriented Gradients
            LBP,           // Local Binary Patterns
            Gabor,         // Gabor filters
            Simple         // Fallback: pixel sampling
        }

        private Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> _knownArcFaceEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();
        private bool _isInitialized = false;

        void Start()
        {
            StartCoroutine(InitializeCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator InitializeCoroutine()
        {
            Debug.Log("🚀 Initializing Enhanced OpenCV Recognizer...");
            Debug.Log($"📊 Feature extraction method: {featureMethod}");
            
            // Load pre-computed ArcFace embeddings from PC preprocessing
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
            
            if (_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count > 0)
            {
                Debug.Log($"✅ Enhanced OpenCV Recognizer initialized!");
                Debug.Log($"📦 Loaded ArcFace embeddings for {_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count} people");
                _isInitialized = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ Initialization failed - No ArcFace embeddings loaded");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load pre-computed ArcFace embeddings from JSON
        /// </summary>
        private IEnumerator LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = System.IO.Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Loading ArcFace embeddings from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
            {
                yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                
                if (www.result == UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                {
                    LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(www.downloadHandler.text);
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to load embeddings: {www.error}");
                }
            }
#else
            if (File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                string jsonContent = File.ReadAllText(fullPath);
                LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(jsonContent);
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {fullPath}");
            }
#endif
            yield break;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Parse embeddings from JSON
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(string jsonContent)
        {
            try
            {
                var data = JsonUtility.FromJson<PreprocessorEmbeddingsData>(jsonContent);
                _knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Clear();
                
                foreach (var person in data.embeddings)
                {
                    List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                    foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                    {
                        // Normalize the ArcFace embeddings
                        float[] normalized = NormalizeVector(embVector.values);
                        embeddingsList.Add(normalized);
                    }
                    _knownArcFaceEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
                }
                
                Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded ArcFace embeddings for {_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count} people:");
                foreach (var kvp in _knownArcFaceEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"   - {kvp.Key}: {kvp.Value.Count} embeddings (size: {kvp.Value[0].Length})");
                }
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to parse embeddings: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract enhanced OpenCV features from a face image
        /// This uses multiple complementary feature descriptors for better accuracy
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractEnhancedFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            switch (featureMethod)
            {
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.MultiScale:
                    return ExtractMultiScaleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.HOG:
                    return ExtractHOGFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.LBP:
                    return ExtractLBPFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.Gabor:
                    return ExtractGaborFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                default:
                    return ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Multi-scale feature extraction (combines multiple descriptors)
        /// This is the BEST option - uses complementary features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractMultiScaleFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            try
            {
                // Standardize input size
                Mat resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(faceGrayMat, resized, new Size(112, 112), interpolation: InterpolationFlags.Area);
                
                // Apply CLAHE for better feature extraction
                Mat enhanced = new Mat();
                using (var clahe = Cv2.CreateCLAHE(clipLimit: 2.0, tileGridSize: new Size(8, 8)))
                {
                    clahe.Apply(resized, enhanced);
                }
                
                List<float> features = new List<float>();
                
                // 1. Multi-scale histogram features (captures overall intensity distribution)
                features.AddRange(ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(enhanced));
                
                // 2. Gradient features (captures edges and shapes - similar to HOG)
                features.AddRange(ExtractGradientFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // 3. Local Binary Pattern features (captures texture)
                features.AddRange(ExtractLBPFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // Cleanup
                resized.Dispose();
                enhanced.Dispose();
                
                // Normalize the combined feature vector
                float[] featureArray = features.ToArray();
                return NormalizeVector(featureArray);
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Multi-scale feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                return ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract histogram features at multiple scales (like ArcFace's spatial features)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            // Divide image into grid (8x8 = 64 regions)
            int gridSize = 8;
            int cellHeight = image.Height / gridSize;
            int cellWidth = image.Width / gridSize;
            
            for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                {
                    Rect roi = new Rect(
                        x * cellWidth,
                        y * cellHeight,
                        cellWidth,
                        cellHeight
                    );
                    
                    using (Mat cell = new Mat(image, roi))
                    {
                        // Calculate mean and std dev for this region
                        Cv2.MeanStdDev(cell, out Scalar mean, out Scalar stddev);
                        features.Add((float)mean.Val0 / 255.0f);
                        features.Add((float)stddev.Val0 / 255.0f);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract gradient-based features (simplified HOG-like approach)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractGradientFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                // Calculate gradients
                Mat gradX = new Mat();
                Mat gradY = new Mat();
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradX, MatType.CV_32F, 1, 0, ksize: 3);
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradY, MatType.CV_32F, 0, 1, ksize: 3);
                
                // Calculate magnitude and angle
                Mat magnitude = new Mat();
                Mat angle = new Mat();
                Cv2.CartToPolar(gradX, gradY, magnitude, angle, angleInDegrees: true);
                
                // Extract histogram of gradients (8 orientations, 8x8 grid)
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = magnitude.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = magnitude.Width / gridSize;
                int numOrientations = 8;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        Rect roi = new Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        
                        using (Mat magCell = new Mat(magnitude, roi))
                        using (Mat angCell = new Mat(angle, roi))
                        {
                            float[] histogram = new float[numOrientations];
                            
                            // Build histogram
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    float mag = magCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    float ang = angCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    int bin = (int)((ang / 360.0f) * numOrientations) % numOrientations;
                                    histogram[bin] += mag;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            // Normalize and add to features
                            float sum = histogram.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < numOrientations; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(histogram[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Cleanup
                gradX.Dispose();
                gradY.Dispose();
                magnitude.Dispose();
                angle.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Gradient feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                // Return zeros if fails
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract Local Binary Pattern features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractLBPFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                // Simple LBP implementation
                Mat lbp = new Mat(image.Size(), MatType.CV_8UC1);
                
                for (int y = 1; y < image.Height - 1; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 1; x < image.Width - 1; x++)
                    {
                        byte center = image.Get<byte>(y, x);
                        byte code = 0;
                        
                        // 8 neighbors
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 1;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x) >= center) code |= 2;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 4;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x + 1) >= center) code |= 8;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 16;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x) >= center) code |= 32;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 64;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x - 1) >= center) code |= 128;
                        
                        lbp.Set(y, x, code);
                    }
                }
                
                // Extract histogram from grid cells
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = lbp.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = lbp.Width / gridSize;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        Rect roi = new Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        using (Mat cell = new Mat(lbp, roi))
                        {
                            // Calculate histogram (256 bins reduced to 8)
                            float[] hist = new float[8];
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    byte val = cell.Get<byte>(r, c);
                                    int bin = val / 32; // Reduce 256 bins to 8
                                    hist[bin]++;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            // Normalize
                            float sum = hist.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(hist[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                lbp.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ LBP feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradients) features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractHOGFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            // For now, use gradient features (HOG is more complex)
            Mat resized = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(image, resized, new Size(112, 112));
            
            float[] features = ExtractGradientFeatures(resized);
            resized.Dispose();
            
            return features;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract Gabor filter features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractGaborFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            // Simplified Gabor - use multi-scale for now
            return ExtractMultiScaleFeatures(image);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Simple feature extraction (fallback)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            Mat resized = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(image, resized, new Size(64, 64));
            
            // Sample pixels in a grid
            for (int y = 0; y < 64; y += 2)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < 64; x += 2)
                {
                    features.Add(resized.Get<byte>(y, x) / 255.0f);
                }
            }
            
            resized.Dispose();
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Normalize a vector to unit length
        /// </summary>
        private float[] NormalizeVector(float[] vector)
        {
            float norm = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                norm += vector[i] * vector[i];
            }
            norm = Mathf.Sqrt(norm);
            
            if (norm < 1e-6f) return vector; // Avoid division by zero
            
            float[] normalized = new float[vector.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                normalized[i] = vector[i] / norm;
            }
            return normalized;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two vectors
        /// </summary>
        private float CalculateCosineSimilarity(float[] vec1, float[] vec2)
        {
            if (vec1.Length != vec2.Length)
            {
                // If lengths don't match, pad or truncate to make them match
                int minLen = Mathf.Min(vec1.Length, vec2.Length);
                int maxLen = Mathf.Max(vec1.Length, vec2.Length);
                
                float[] newVec1 = new float[maxLen];
                float[] newVec2 = new float[maxLen];
                
                for (int i = 0; i < maxLen; i++)
                {
                    newVec1[i] = i < vec1.Length ? vec1[i] : 0f;
                    newVec2[i] = i < vec2.Length ? vec2[i] : 0f;
                }
                
                vec1 = newVec1;
                vec2 = newVec2;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0f;
            float norm1 = 0f;
            float norm2 = 0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < vec1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += vec1[i] * vec2[i];
                norm1 += vec1[i] * vec1[i];
                norm2 += vec2[i] * vec2[i];
            }

            if (norm1 < 1e-6f || norm2 < 1e-6f)
            {
                return 0f;
            }

            return dotProduct / (Mathf.Sqrt(norm1) * Mathf.Sqrt(norm2));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face using enhanced OpenCV features compared to ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public string RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized)
            {
                return "System not initialized";
            }

            if (_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                return "No known faces loaded";
            }

            try
            {
                // Extract enhanced features from live face
                float[] liveFeatures = ExtractEnhancedFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                
                if (liveFeatures == null || liveFeatures.Length == 0)
                {
                    return "Failed to extract features";
                }

                // Find best match against ArcFace embeddings
                string bestMatch = "Unknown";
                float bestSimilarity = 0f;
                
                foreach (var kvp in _knownArcFaceEmbeddings)
                {
                    string personName = kvp.Key;
                    List<float[]> storedEmbeddings = kvp.Value;
                    
                    foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in storedEmbeddings)
                    {
                        float similarity = CalculateCosineSimilarity(liveFeatures, storedEmbedding);
                        
                        if (similarity > bestSimilarity)
                        {
                            bestSimilarity = similarity;
                            bestMatch = personName;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Apply threshold
                if (bestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
                {
                    // Check if person should be shown as anonymous
                    if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                    {
                        if (enableDebugLogging)
                        {
                            Debug.Log($"🎭 [{featureMethod}] Recognized {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3}) → Showing as Unknown");
                        }
                        bestMatch = "Unknown";
                    }
                    else if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"✅ [{featureMethod}] Recognized: {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3})");
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"❌ [{featureMethod}] Best match {bestMatch} below threshold (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3} < {similarityThreshold})");
                    }
                    bestMatch = "Unknown";
                }

                return bestMatch;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Face recognition failed: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return "Recognition failed";
            }
        }

        public bool IsReady()
        {
            return _isInitialized && _knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count > 0;
```
```csharp
        }
    }
}

                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        Rect roi = new Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        
                        using (Mat magCell = new Mat(magnitude, roi))
                        using (Mat angCell = new Mat(angle, roi))
                        {
                            float[] histogram = new float[numOrientations];
                            
                            // Build histogram
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    float mag = magCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    float ang = angCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    int bin = (int)((ang / 360.0f) * numOrientations) % numOrientations;
                                    histogram[bin] += mag;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            // Normalize and add to features
                            float sum = histogram.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < numOrientations; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(histogram[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Cleanup
                gradX.Dispose();
                gradY.Dispose();
                magnitude.Dispose();
                angle.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Gradient feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                // Return zeros if fails
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract Local Binary Pattern features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractLBPFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                // Simple LBP implementation
                Mat lbp = new Mat(image.Size(), MatType.CV_8UC1);
                
                for (int y = 1; y < image.Height - 1; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 1; x < image.Width - 1; x++)
                    {
                        byte center = image.Get<byte>(y, x);
                        byte code = 0;
                        
                        // 8 neighbors
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 1;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x) >= center) code |= 2;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 4;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x + 1) >= center) code |= 8;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 16;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x) >= center) code |= 32;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 64;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x - 1) >= center) code |= 128;
                        
                        lbp.Set(y, x, code);
                    }
                }
                
                // Extract histogram from grid cells
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = lbp.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = lbp.Width / gridSize;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        Rect roi = new Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        using (Mat cell = new Mat(lbp, roi))
                        {
                            // Calculate histogram (256 bins reduced to 8)
                            float[] hist = new float[8];
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    byte val = cell.Get<byte>(r, c);
                                    int bin = val / 32; // Reduce 256 bins to 8
                                    hist[bin]++;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            // Normalize
                            float sum = hist.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(hist[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                lbp.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ LBP feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradients) features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractHOGFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            // For now, use gradient features (HOG is more complex)
            Mat resized = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(image, resized, new Size(112, 112));
            
            float[] features = ExtractGradientFeatures(resized);
            resized.Dispose();
            
            return features;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract Gabor filter features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractGaborFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            // Simplified Gabor - use multi-scale for now
            return ExtractMultiScaleFeatures(image);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Simple feature extraction (fallback)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            Mat resized = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(image, resized, new Size(64, 64));
            
            // Sample pixels in a grid
            for (int y = 0; y < 64; y += 2)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < 64; x += 2)
                {
                    features.Add(resized.Get<byte>(y, x) / 255.0f);
                }
            }
            
            resized.Dispose();
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Normalize a vector to unit length
        /// </summary>
        private float[] NormalizeVector(float[] vector)
        {
            float norm = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                norm += vector[i] * vector[i];
            }
            norm = Mathf.Sqrt(norm);
            
            if (norm < 1e-6f) return vector; // Avoid division by zero
            
            float[] normalized = new float[vector.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                normalized[i] = vector[i] / norm;
            }
            return normalized;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two vectors
        /// </summary>
        private float CalculateCosineSimilarity(float[] vec1, float[] vec2)
        {
            if (vec1.Length != vec2.Length)
            {
                // If lengths don't match, pad or truncate to make them match
                int minLen = Mathf.Min(vec1.Length, vec2.Length);
                int maxLen = Mathf.Max(vec1.Length, vec2.Length);
                
                float[] newVec1 = new float[maxLen];
                float[] newVec2 = new float[maxLen];
                
                for (int i = 0; i < maxLen; i++)
                {
                    newVec1[i] = i < vec1.Length ? vec1[i] : 0f;
                    newVec2[i] = i < vec2.Length ? vec2[i] : 0f;
                }
                
                vec1 = newVec1;
                vec2 = newVec2;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0f;
            float norm1 = 0f;
            float norm2 = 0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < vec1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += vec1[i] * vec2[i];
                norm1 += vec1[i] * vec1[i];
                norm2 += vec2[i] * vec2[i];
            }

            if (norm1 < 1e-6f || norm2 < 1e-6f)
            {
                return 0f;
            }

            return dotProduct / (Mathf.Sqrt(norm1) * Mathf.Sqrt(norm2));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face using enhanced OpenCV features compared to ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public string RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized)
            {
                return "System not initialized";
            }

            if (_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                return "No known faces loaded";
            }

            try
            {
                // Extract enhanced features from live face
                float[] liveFeatures = ExtractEnhancedFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                
                if (liveFeatures == null || liveFeatures.Length == 0)
                {
                    return "Failed to extract features";
                }

                // Find best match against ArcFace embeddings
                string bestMatch = "Unknown";
                float bestSimilarity = 0f;
                
                foreach (var kvp in _knownArcFaceEmbeddings)
                {
                    string personName = kvp.Key;
                    List<float[]> storedEmbeddings = kvp.Value;
                    
                    foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in storedEmbeddings)
                    {
                        float similarity = CalculateCosineSimilarity(liveFeatures, storedEmbedding);
                        
                        if (similarity > bestSimilarity)
                        {
                            bestSimilarity = similarity;
                            bestMatch = personName;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Apply threshold
                if (bestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
                {
                    // Check if person should be shown as anonymous
                    if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                    {
                        if (enableDebugLogging)
                        {
                            Debug.Log($"🎭 [{featureMethod}] Recognized {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3}) → Showing as Unknown");
                        }
                        bestMatch = "Unknown";
                    }
                    else if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"✅ [{featureMethod}] Recognized: {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3})");
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"❌ [{featureMethod}] Best match {bestMatch} below threshold (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3} < {similarityThreshold})");
                    }
                    bestMatch = "Unknown";
                }

                return bestMatch;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Face recognition failed: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return "Recognition failed";
            }
        }

        public bool IsReady()
        {
            return _isInitialized && _knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count > 0;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using OpenCvSharp;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine.Networking;
using System.Collections;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Enhanced OpenCV-based face recognizer that uses the ArcFace embeddings
    /// generated on PC for training, and uses improved OpenCV features for live recognition.
    /// 
    /// This is the implementation of yesterday's breakthrough idea:
    /// - Use ArcFace on PC to get high-quality training embeddings
    /// - Use lightweight OpenCV features on device for live recognition
    /// - Compare using cosine similarity
    /// 
    /// No heavy models needed on device!
    /// </summary>
    public class EnhancedOpenCVRecognizer : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Settings")]
        [Tooltip("Path to pre-computed ArcFace embeddings")]
        public string embeddingsFilePath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Tooltip("Similarity threshold (0.0-1.0, higher = stricter)")]
        [Range(0.0f, 1.0f)]
        public float similarityThreshold = 0.35f; // Lower for enhanced features
        
        [Tooltip("Names to show as 'Unknown' even when recognized")]
        public List<string> anonymousNames = new List<string> { "Obama", "Jshlatt", "ScarlettJohansson" };
        
        [Tooltip("Enable debug logging")]
        public bool enableDebugLogging = true;
        
        [Tooltip("Feature extraction method")]
        public FeatureExtractionMethod featureMethod = FeatureExtractionMethod.MultiScale;

        public enum FeatureExtractionMethod
        {
            MultiScale,     // Best: combines multiple feature types
            HOG,           // Histogram of Oriented Gradients
            LBP,           // Local Binary Patterns
            Gabor,         // Gabor filters
            Simple         // Fallback: pixel sampling
        }

        private Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> _knownArcFaceEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();
        private bool _isInitialized = false;

        void Start()
        {
            StartCoroutine(InitializeCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator InitializeCoroutine()
        {
            Debug.Log("🚀 Initializing Enhanced OpenCV Recognizer...");
            Debug.Log($"📊 Feature extraction method: {featureMethod}");
            
            // Load pre-computed ArcFace embeddings from PC preprocessing
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
            
            if (_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count > 0)
            {
                Debug.Log($"✅ Enhanced OpenCV Recognizer initialized!");
                Debug.Log($"📦 Loaded ArcFace embeddings for {_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count} people");
                _isInitialized = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ Initialization failed - No ArcFace embeddings loaded");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load pre-computed ArcFace embeddings from JSON
        /// </summary>
        private IEnumerator LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = System.IO.Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Loading ArcFace embeddings from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
            {
                yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                
                if (www.result == UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                {
                    LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(www.downloadHandler.text);
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to load embeddings: {www.error}");
                }
            }
#else
            if (File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                string jsonContent = File.ReadAllText(fullPath);
                LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(jsonContent);
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {fullPath}");
            }
#endif
            yield break;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Parse embeddings from JSON
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(string jsonContent)
        {
            try
            {
                var data = JsonUtility.FromJson<PreprocessorEmbeddingsData>(jsonContent);
                _knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Clear();
                
                foreach (var person in data.embeddings)
                {
                    List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                    foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                    {
                        // Normalize the ArcFace embeddings
                        float[] normalized = NormalizeVector(embVector.values);
                        embeddingsList.Add(normalized);
                    }
                    _knownArcFaceEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
                }
                
                Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded ArcFace embeddings for {_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count} people:");
                foreach (var kvp in _knownArcFaceEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"   - {kvp.Key}: {kvp.Value.Count} embeddings (size: {kvp.Value[0].Length})");
                }
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to parse embeddings: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract enhanced OpenCV features from a face image
        /// This uses multiple complementary feature descriptors for better accuracy
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractEnhancedFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            switch (featureMethod)
            {
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.MultiScale:
                    return ExtractMultiScaleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.HOG:
                    return ExtractHOGFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.LBP:
                    return ExtractLBPFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.Gabor:
                    return ExtractGaborFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                default:
                    return ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Multi-scale feature extraction (combines multiple descriptors)
        /// This is the BEST option - uses complementary features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractMultiScaleFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            try
            {
                // Standardize input size
                Mat resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(faceGrayMat, resized, new Size(112, 112), interpolation: InterpolationFlags.Area);
                
                // Apply CLAHE for better feature extraction
                Mat enhanced = new Mat();
                using (var clahe = Cv2.CreateCLAHE(clipLimit: 2.0, tileGridSize: new Size(8, 8)))
                {
                    clahe.Apply(resized, enhanced);
                }
                
                List<float> features = new List<float>();
                
                // 1. Multi-scale histogram features (captures overall intensity distribution)
                features.AddRange(ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(enhanced));
                
                // 2. Gradient features (captures edges and shapes - similar to HOG)
                features.AddRange(ExtractGradientFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // 3. Local Binary Pattern features (captures texture)
                features.AddRange(ExtractLBPFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // Cleanup
                resized.Dispose();
                enhanced.Dispose();
                
                // Normalize the combined feature vector
                float[] featureArray = features.ToArray();
                return NormalizeVector(featureArray);
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Multi-scale feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                return ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract histogram features at multiple scales (like ArcFace's spatial features)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            // Divide image into grid (8x8 = 64 regions)
            int gridSize = 8;
            int cellHeight = image.Height / gridSize;
            int cellWidth = image.Width / gridSize;
            
            for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                {
                    OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                        x * cellWidth,
                        y * cellHeight,
                        cellWidth,
                        cellHeight
                    );
                    
                    using (Mat cell = image.SubMat(roi))
                    {
                        // Calculate mean and std dev for this region
                        Cv2.MeanStdDev(cell, out Scalar mean, out Scalar stddev);
                        features.Add((float)mean.Val0 / 255.0f);
                        features.Add((float)stddev.Val0 / 255.0f);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract gradient-based features (simplified HOG-like approach)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractGradientFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                // Calculate gradients
                Mat gradX = new Mat();
                Mat gradY = new Mat();
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradX, MatType.CV_32F, 1, 0, ksize: 3);
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradY, MatType.CV_32F, 0, 1, ksize: 3);
                
                // Calculate magnitude and angle
                Mat magnitude = new Mat();
                Mat angle = new Mat();
                Cv2.CartToPolar(gradX, gradY, magnitude, angle, angleInDegrees: true);
                
                // Extract histogram of gradients (8 orientations, 8x8 grid)
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = magnitude.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = magnitude.Width / gridSize;
                int numOrientations = 8;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        
                        using (Mat magCell = magnitude.SubMat(roi))
                        using (Mat angCell = angle.SubMat(roi))
                        {
                            float[] histogram = new float[numOrientations];
                            
                            // Build histogram
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    float mag = magCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    float ang = angCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    int bin = (int)((ang / 360.0f) * numOrientations) % numOrientations;
                                    histogram[bin] += mag;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            // Normalize and add to features
                            float sum = histogram.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < numOrientations; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(histogram[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Cleanup
                gradX.Dispose();
                gradY.Dispose();
                magnitude.Dispose();
                angle.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Gradient feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                // Return zeros if fails
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract Local Binary Pattern features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractLBPFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                // Simple LBP implementation
                Mat lbp = new Mat(image.Size(), MatType.CV_8UC1);

                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 4;

                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 16;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x) >= center) code |= 32;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 64;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x - 1) >= center) code |= 128;
                        
                        lbp.Set(y, x, code);

                // Extract histogram from grid cells

                            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)

            }

                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradients) features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractHOGFeatures(Mat image)

            // For now, use gradient features (HOG is more complex)

        private float[] ExtractGaborFeatures(Mat image)

        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Simple feature extraction (fallback)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(Mat image)

        /// <summary>

        private float[] NormalizeVector(float[] vector)
        {
            float norm = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {

            if (norm < 1e-6f) return vector; // Avoid division by zero

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two vectors
        /// </summary>
        private float CalculateCosineSimilarity(float[] vec1, float[] vec2)
        {

            {
                // If lengths don't match, pad or truncate to make them match
                int minLen = Mathf.Min(vec1.Length, vec2.Length);
                int maxLen = Mathf.Max(vec1.Length, vec2.Length);

                dotProduct += vec1[i] * vec2[i];
                norm1 += vec1[i] * vec1[i];
                norm2 += vec2[i] * vec2[i];
            }

            if (norm1 < 1e-6f || norm2 < 1e-6f)
            {
                return 0f;
            }

            return dotProduct / (Mathf.Sqrt(norm1) * Mathf.Sqrt(norm2));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face using enhanced OpenCV features compared to ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public string RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized)
            {
                return "System not initialized";
            }

            if (_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                return "No known faces loaded";
            }

            try
            {
                // Extract enhanced features from live face
                float[] liveFeatures = ExtractEnhancedFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                
                if (liveFeatures == null || liveFeatures.Length == 0)
                {
                    return "Failed to extract features";
                }

                // Find best match against ArcFace embeddings
                string bestMatch = "Unknown";
                float bestSimilarity = 0f;
                
                foreach (var kvp in _knownArcFaceEmbeddings)
                {
                    string personName = kvp.Key;
                    List<float[]> storedEmbeddings = kvp.Value;
                    
                    foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in storedEmbeddings)
                    {
                        float similarity = CalculateCosineSimilarity(liveFeatures, storedEmbedding);
                        
                        if (similarity > bestSimilarity)
                        {
                            bestSimilarity = similarity;
                            bestMatch = personName;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Apply threshold
                if (bestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
                {
                    // Check if person should be shown as anonymous
                    if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                    {
                        if (enableDebugLogging)
                        {
                            Debug.Log($"🎭 [{featureMethod}] Recognized {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3}) → Showing as Unknown");
                        }
                        bestMatch = "Unknown";
                    }
                    else if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"✅ [{featureMethod}] Recognized: {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3})");
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"❌ [{featureMethod}] Best match {bestMatch} below threshold (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3} < {similarityThreshold})");
                    }
                    bestMatch = "Unknown";
                }

                return bestMatch;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Face recognition failed: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return "Recognition failed";
            }
        }

        public bool IsReady()
        {
            return _isInitialized && _knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count > 0;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using OpenCvSharp;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Enhanced OpenCV-based face recognizer that uses the ArcFace embeddings
    /// generated on PC for training, and uses improved OpenCV features for live recognition.
    /// 
    /// This is the implementation of yesterday's breakthrough idea:
    /// - Use ArcFace on PC to get high-quality training embeddings
    /// - Use lightweight OpenCV features on device for live recognition
    /// - Compare using cosine similarity
    /// 
    /// No heavy models needed on device!
    /// </summary>
    public class EnhancedOpenCVRecognizer : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Settings")]
        [Tooltip("Path to pre-computed ArcFace embeddings")]
        public string embeddingsFilePath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Tooltip("Similarity threshold (0.0-1.0, higher = stricter)")]
        [Range(0.0f, 1.0f)]
        public float similarityThreshold = 0.35f; // Lower for enhanced features
        
        [Tooltip("Names to show as 'Unknown' even when recognized")]
        public List<string> anonymousNames = new List<string> { "Obama", "Jshlatt", "ScarlettJohansson" };
        
        [Tooltip("Enable debug logging")]
        public bool enableDebugLogging = true;
        
        [Tooltip("Feature extraction method")]
        public FeatureExtractionMethod featureMethod = FeatureExtractionMethod.MultiScale;

        public enum FeatureExtractionMethod
        {
            MultiScale,     // Best: combines multiple feature types
            HOG,           // Histogram of Oriented Gradients
            LBP,           // Local Binary Patterns
            Gabor,         // Gabor filters
            Simple         // Fallback: pixel sampling
        }

        private Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> _knownArcFaceEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();
        private bool _isInitialized = false;

        void Start()
        {
            StartCoroutine(InitializeCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator InitializeCoroutine()
        {
            Debug.Log("🚀 Initializing Enhanced OpenCV Recognizer...");
            Debug.Log($"📊 Feature extraction method: {featureMethod}");
            
            // Load pre-computed ArcFace embeddings from PC preprocessing
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
            
            if (_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count > 0)
            {
                Debug.Log($"✅ Enhanced OpenCV Recognizer initialized!");
                Debug.Log($"📦 Loaded ArcFace embeddings for {_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count} people");
                _isInitialized = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ Initialization failed - No ArcFace embeddings loaded");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load pre-computed ArcFace embeddings from JSON
        /// </summary>
        private IEnumerator LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = System.IO.Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Loading ArcFace embeddings from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
            {
                yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                
                if (www.result == UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                {
                    LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(www.downloadHandler.text);
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to load embeddings: {www.error}");
                }
            }
#else
            if (File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                string jsonContent = File.ReadAllText(fullPath);
                LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(jsonContent);
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {fullPath}");
            }
#endif
            yield break;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Parse embeddings from JSON
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(string jsonContent)
        {
            try
            {
                var data = JsonUtility.FromJson<PreprocessorEmbeddingsData>(jsonContent);
                _knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Clear();
                
                foreach (var person in data.embeddings)
                {
                    List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                    foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                    {
                        // Normalize the ArcFace embeddings
                        float[] normalized = NormalizeVector(embVector.values);
                        embeddingsList.Add(normalized);
                    }
                    _knownArcFaceEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
                }
                
                Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded ArcFace embeddings for {_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count} people:");
                foreach (var kvp in _knownArcFaceEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"   - {kvp.Key}: {kvp.Value.Count} embeddings (size: {kvp.Value[0].Length})");
                }
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to parse embeddings: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract enhanced OpenCV features from a face image
        /// This uses multiple complementary feature descriptors for better accuracy
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractEnhancedFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            switch (featureMethod)
            {
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.MultiScale:
                    return ExtractMultiScaleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.HOG:
                    return ExtractHOGFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.LBP:
                    return ExtractLBPFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                case FeatureExtractionMethod.Gabor:
                    return ExtractGaborFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                default:
                    return ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Multi-scale feature extraction (combines multiple descriptors)
        /// This is the BEST option - uses complementary features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractMultiScaleFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            try
            {
                // Standardize input size
                Mat resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(faceGrayMat, resized, new Size(112, 112), interpolation: InterpolationFlags.Area);
                
                // Apply CLAHE for better feature extraction
                Mat enhanced = new Mat();
                using (var clahe = Cv2.CreateCLAHE(clipLimit: 2.0, tileGridSize: new Size(8, 8)))
                {
                    clahe.Apply(resized, enhanced);
                }
                
                List<float> features = new List<float>();
                
                // 1. Multi-scale histogram features (captures overall intensity distribution)
                features.AddRange(ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(enhanced));
                
                // 2. Gradient features (captures edges and shapes - similar to HOG)
                features.AddRange(ExtractGradientFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // 3. Local Binary Pattern features (captures texture)
                features.AddRange(ExtractLBPFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // Cleanup
                resized.Dispose();
                enhanced.Dispose();
                
                // Normalize the combined feature vector
                float[] featureArray = features.ToArray();
                return NormalizeVector(featureArray);
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Multi-scale feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                return ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract histogram features at multiple scales (like ArcFace's spatial features)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            // Divide image into grid (8x8 = 64 regions)
            int gridSize = 8;
            int cellHeight = image.Height / gridSize;
            int cellWidth = image.Width / gridSize;
            
            for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                {
                    OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                        x * cellWidth,
                        y * cellHeight,
                        cellWidth,
                        cellHeight
                    );
                    
                    using (Mat cell = image.SubMat(roi))
                    {
                        // Calculate mean and std dev for this region
                        Cv2.MeanStdDev(cell, out Scalar mean, out Scalar stddev);
                        features.Add((float)mean.Val0 / 255.0f);
                        features.Add((float)stddev.Val0 / 255.0f);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract gradient-based features (simplified HOG-like approach)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractGradientFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                // Calculate gradients
                Mat gradX = new Mat();
                Mat gradY = new Mat();
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradX, MatType.CV_32F, 1, 0, ksize: 3);
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradY, MatType.CV_32F, 0, 1, ksize: 3);
                
                // Calculate magnitude and angle
                Mat magnitude = new Mat();
                Mat angle = new Mat();
                Cv2.CartToPolar(gradX, gradY, magnitude, angle, angleInDegrees: true);
                
                // Extract histogram of gradients (8 orientations, 8x8 grid)
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = magnitude.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = magnitude.Width / gridSize;
                int numOrientations = 8;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        
                        using (Mat magCell = magnitude.SubMat(roi))
                        using (Mat angCell = angle.SubMat(roi))
                        {
                            float[] histogram = new float[numOrientations];
                            
                            // Build histogram
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    float mag = magCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    float ang = angCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    int bin = (int)((ang / 360.0f) * numOrientations) % numOrientations;
                                    histogram[bin] += mag;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            // Normalize and add to features
                            float sum = histogram.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < numOrientations; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(histogram[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Cleanup
                gradX.Dispose();
                gradY.Dispose();
                magnitude.Dispose();
                angle.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Gradient feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                // Return zeros if fails
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract Local Binary Pattern features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractLBPFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                // Simple LBP implementation
                Mat lbp = new Mat(image.Size(), MatType.CV_8UC1);
                
                for (int y = 1; y < image.Height - 1; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 1; x < image.Width - 1; x++)
                    {
                        byte center = image.Get<byte>(y, x);
                        byte code = 0;
                        
                        // 8 neighbors
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 1;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x) >= center) code |= 2;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 4;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x + 1) >= center) code |= 8;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 16;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x) >= center) code |= 32;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 64;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x - 1) >= center) code |= 128;
                        
                        lbp.Set(y, x, code);
                    }
                }
                
                // Extract histogram from grid cells
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = lbp.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = lbp.Width / gridSize;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        using (Mat cell = lbp.SubMat(roi))
                        {
                            // Calculate histogram (256 bins reduced to 8)
                            float[] hist = new float[8];
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    byte val = cell.Get<byte>(r, c);
                                    int bin = val / 32; // Reduce 256 bins to 8
                                    hist[bin]++;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            // Normalize
                            float sum = hist.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(hist[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                lbp.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ LBP feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradients) features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractHOGFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            // For now, use gradient features (HOG is more complex)
            Mat resized = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(image, resized, new Size(112, 112));
            
            float[] features = ExtractGradientFeatures(resized);
            resized.Dispose();
            
            return features;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract Gabor filter features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractGaborFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            // Simplified Gabor - use multi-scale for now
            return ExtractMultiScaleFeatures(image);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Simple feature extraction (fallback)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            Mat resized = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(image, resized, new Size(64, 64));
            
            // Sample pixels in a grid
            for (int y = 0; y < 64; y += 2)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < 64; x += 2)
                {
                    features.Add(resized.Get<byte>(y, x) / 255.0f);
                }
            }
            
            resized.Dispose();
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Normalize a vector to unit length
        /// </summary>
        private float[] NormalizeVector(float[] vector)
        {
            float norm = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                norm += vector[i] * vector[i];
            }
            norm = Mathf.Sqrt(norm);
            
            if (norm < 1e-6f) return vector; // Avoid division by zero
            
            float[] normalized = new float[vector.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                normalized[i] = vector[i] / norm;
            }
            return normalized;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two vectors
        /// </summary>
        private float CalculateCosineSimilarity(float[] vec1, float[] vec2)
        {
            if (vec1.Length != vec2.Length)
            {
                // If lengths don't match, pad or truncate to make them match
                int minLen = Mathf.Min(vec1.Length, vec2.Length);
                int maxLen = Mathf.Max(vec1.Length, vec2.Length);
                
                float[] newVec1 = new float[maxLen];
                float[] newVec2 = new float[maxLen];
                
                for (int i = 0; i < maxLen; i++)
                {
                    newVec1[i] = i < vec1.Length ? vec1[i] : 0f;
                    newVec2[i] = i < vec2.Length ? vec2[i] : 0f;
                }
                
                vec1 = newVec1;
                vec2 = newVec2;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0f;
            float norm1 = 0f;
            float norm2 = 0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < vec1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += vec1[i] * vec2[i];
                norm1 += vec1[i] * vec1[i];
                norm2 += vec2[i] * vec2[i];
            }

            if (norm1 < 1e-6f || norm2 < 1e-6f)
            {
                return 0f;
            }

            return dotProduct / (Mathf.Sqrt(norm1) * Mathf.Sqrt(norm2));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face using enhanced OpenCV features compared to ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public string RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized)
            {
                return "System not initialized";
            }

            if (_knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                return "No known faces loaded";
            }

            try
            {
                // Extract enhanced features from live face
                float[] liveFeatures = ExtractEnhancedFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                
                if (liveFeatures == null || liveFeatures.Length == 0)
                {
                    return "Failed to extract features";
                }

                // Find best match against ArcFace embeddings
                string bestMatch = "Unknown";
                float bestSimilarity = 0f;
                
                foreach (var kvp in _knownArcFaceEmbeddings)
                {
                    string personName = kvp.Key;
                    List<float[]> storedEmbeddings = kvp.Value;
                    
                    foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in storedEmbeddings)
                    {
                        float similarity = CalculateCosineSimilarity(liveFeatures, storedEmbedding);
                        
                        if (similarity > bestSimilarity)
                        {
                            bestSimilarity = similarity;
                            bestMatch = personName;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Apply threshold
                if (bestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
                {
                    // Check if person should be shown as anonymous
                    if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                    {
                        if (enableDebugLogging)
                        {
                            Debug.Log($"🎭 [{featureMethod}] Recognized {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3}) → Showing as Unknown");
                        }
                        bestMatch = "Unknown";
                    }
                    else if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"✅ [{featureMethod}] Recognized: {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3})");
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"❌ [{featureMethod}] Best match {bestMatch} below threshold (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3} < {similarityThreshold})");
                    }
                    bestMatch = "Unknown";
                }

                return bestMatch;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Face recognition failed: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return "Recognition failed";
            }
        }

        {
            return _isInitialized && _knownArcFaceEmbeddings.Count > 0;
```

## Solution: Generate Compatible Features on PC

Instead of trying to compare different feature types, let's:

1. **On PC**: Generate BOTH ArcFace embeddings AND the same OpenCV features we use on device
2. **Save both** to JSON
3. **On device**: Extract OpenCV features from live face and compare to the PC-generated OpenCV features

This way we're comparing **OpenCV to OpenCV**, but the OpenCV features are extracted from high-quality images on PC!

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using OpenCvSharp;
using OpenCvSharp.Dnn;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using UnityEditor;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Editor-only tool to preprocess training images and generate embeddings using the large ArcFace model.
    /// This runs ONLY in the Unity Editor on your PC, not on Magic Leap 2.
    /// Uses OpenCV DNN module instead of Barracuda for better compatibility.
    /// The generated embeddings are small and can be loaded on the device.
    /// </summary>
    public class FaceEmbeddingPreprocessor : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Editor-Only Settings (PC)")]
        [Tooltip("Path to ArcFace ONNX model (in Assets folder)")]
        public string onnxModelPath = "Models/arcface.onnx";
        
        [Tooltip("Path to training data folder (relative to StreamingAssets)")]
        public string trainingDataFolder = "Faces";
        
        [Tooltip("Where to save the generated embeddings (relative to StreamingAssets)")]
        public string embeddingsOutputPath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Header("Processing Status")]
        public bool isProcessing = false;
        public int totalImagesProcessed = 0;
        public string statusMessage = "Ready to process";
        
        private const int MODEL_INPUT_SIZE = 112; // ArcFace input size
        private Net _dnnModel;

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embeddings for all training images (call from Inspector context menu)
        /// </summary>
        [ContextMenu("Generate Embeddings (Editor Only)")]
        public void GenerateEmbeddings()
        {
            if (Application.isPlaying)
            {
```
