```csharp
                return;
            }

            Debug.Log("🚀 Starting embedding generation on PC...");
            isProcessing = true;
            totalImagesProcessed = 0;

            try
            {
                // Load the large ArcFace model using OpenCV DNN
                string modelFullPath = Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, onnxModelPath);
                
                if (!File.Exists(modelFullPath))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Model file not found: {modelFullPath}");
                    return;
                }

                Debug.Log($"📦 Loading model from: {modelFullPath}");
                _dnnModel = Net.ReadNetFromONNX(modelFullPath);
                
                if (_dnnModel == null || _dnnModel.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to load ONNX model with OpenCV DNN");
                    return;
                }

                Debug.Log("✅ Large model loaded successfully with OpenCV DNN!");

                // Process all training images
                string trainingDataPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, trainingDataFolder);
                
                if (!Directory.Exists(trainingDataPath))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Training data folder not found: {trainingDataPath}");
                    return;
                }

                // Dictionary to hold embeddings for each person
                Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> allEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();

                // Get all person folders
                string[] personFolders = Directory.GetDirectories(trainingDataPath);
                Debug.Log($"📂 Found {personFolders.Length} people to process");

                foreach (string personFolder in personFolders)
                {
                    string personName = Path.GetFileName(personFolder);
                    
                    if (personName == "Unknown" || personName.StartsWith("."))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    Debug.Log($"📸 Processing {personName}...");
                    statusMessage = $"Processing {personName}...";

                    // Get all images for this person
                    string[] imageExtensions = { "*.jpg", "*.jpeg", "*.png", "*.bmp" };
                    List<string> imageFiles = new List<string>();
                    
                    foreach (string extension in imageExtensions)
                    {
                        imageFiles.AddRange(Directory.GetFiles(personFolder, extension, SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly));
                    }

                    if (imageFiles.Count == 0)
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ No images found for {personName}");
                        continue;
                    }

                    List<float[]> personEmbeddings = new List<float[]>();

                    // Process each image
                    foreach (string imagePath in imageFiles)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            float[] embedding = GenerateEmbeddingForImage(imagePath);
                            if (embedding != null)
                            {
                                personEmbeddings.Add(embedding);
                                totalImagesProcessed++;
                            }
                        }
                        catch (System.Exception e)
                        {
                            Debug.LogError($"❌ Error processing {imagePath}: {e.Message}");
                        }
                    }

                    if (personEmbeddings.Count > 0)
                    {
                        allEmbeddings[personName] = personEmbeddings;
                        Debug.Log($"✅ Generated {personEmbeddings.Count} embeddings for {personName}");
                    }
                }

                // Save embeddings to file
                SaveEmbeddingsToFile(allEmbeddings);

                Debug.Log($"🎉 SUCCESS! Processed {totalImagesProcessed} images for {allEmbeddings.Count} people!");
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Fatal error during embedding generation: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                _dnnModel?.Dispose();
                isProcessing = false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embedding for a single image using OpenCV DNN
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateEmbeddingForImage(string imagePath)
        {
            Mat image = null;
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat blob = null;
            Mat output = null;

            try
            {
                // Load image
                image = Cv2.ImRead(imagePath, ImreadModes.Color);
                if (image.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Failed to load image: {imagePath}");
                    return null;
                }

                // Convert to RGB (OpenCV loads as BGR)
                rgbImage = new Mat();
                Cv2.CvtColor(image, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2RGB);

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Create blob from image (normalized to [0, 1])
                // OpenCV DNN expects: (batch, channels, height, width)
                blob = CvDnn.BlobFromImage(
                    resized,
                    1.0 / 255.0,  // scale factor - Normalize to [0, 1]
                    new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE),
                    new Scalar(0, 0, 0),  // mean
                    false,  // swapRB - We already converted to RGB
                    false   // crop
                );

                // Run inference
                _dnnModel.SetInput(blob);
                output = _dnnModel.Forward();

                // Extract embedding as float array
                int embeddingSize = (int)output.Total();
                float[] embedding = new float[embeddingSize];
                
                // Get indexer for safe access
                var indexer = output.GetGenericIndexer<float>();
                
                // Copy data from Mat to array
                for (int i = 0; i < embeddingSize; i++)
                {
                    embedding[i] = indexer[0, i];
                }

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error processing image {imagePath}: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                image?.Dispose();
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                blob?.Dispose();
                output?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Save embeddings to JSON file
        /// </summary>
        private void SaveEmbeddingsToFile(Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> embeddings)
        {
            string outputPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsOutputPath);
            
            // Convert to serializable format
            PreprocessorEmbeddingsData data = new PreprocessorEmbeddingsData
            {
                embeddings = new List<PersonEmbeddings>()
            };

            foreach (var kvp in embeddings)
            {
                PersonEmbeddings personData = new PersonEmbeddings
                {
                    name = kvp.Key,
                    embeddings = new List<EmbeddingVector>()
                };

                foreach (float[] embedding in kvp.Value)
                {
                    personData.embeddings.Add(new EmbeddingVector { values = embedding });
                }

                data.embeddings.Add(personData);
            }

            // Serialize to JSON
            string json = JsonUtility.ToJson(data, prettyPrint: true);
            File.WriteAllText(outputPath, json);

            Debug.Log($"💾 Embeddings saved to: {outputPath}");
            Debug.Log($"📦 File size: {new FileInfo(outputPath).Length / 1024.0:F2} KB");
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            _dnnModel?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    // Serializable classes for JSON export
    [System.Serializable]
    public class PreprocessorEmbeddingsData
    {
        public List<PersonEmbeddings> embeddings;
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public class PersonEmbeddings
    {
        public string name;
        public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        public List<EmbeddingVector> opencvFeatures; // NEW: OpenCV-compatible features
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public class EmbeddingVector
    {
        public float[] values;
    }
}
```

```csharp
        /// <summary>
        /// Generate OpenCV-compatible features for a single image (same as device will use)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateOpenCVFeaturesForImage(string imagePath)
        {
            Mat image = null;
            Mat grayImage = null;
            
            try
            {
                // Load image
                image = Cv2.ImRead(imagePath, ImreadModes.Color);
                if (image.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Failed to load image: {imagePath}");
                    return null;
                }

                // Convert to grayscale
                grayImage = new Mat();
                Cv2.CvtColor(image, grayImage, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);

                // Resize to standard size (same as device)
                Mat resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(grayImage, resized, new Size(112, 112), interpolation: InterpolationFlags.Area);
                
                // Apply CLAHE (same as device)
                Mat enhanced = new Mat();
                using (var clahe = Cv2.CreateCLAHE(clipLimit: 2.0, tileGridSize: new Size(8, 8)))
                {
                    clahe.Apply(resized, enhanced);
                }
                
                // Extract multi-scale features (SAME as EnhancedOpenCVRecognizer)
                List<float> features = new List<float>();
                
                // 1. Multi-scale histogram features
                features.AddRange(ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(enhanced));
                
                // 2. Gradient features
                features.AddRange(ExtractGradientFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // 3. LBP features
                features.AddRange(ExtractLBPFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // Cleanup
                resized.Dispose();
                enhanced.Dispose();
                
                // Normalize
                float[] featureArray = features.ToArray();
                return NormalizeVector(featureArray);
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error extracting OpenCV features from {imagePath}: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                image?.Dispose();
                grayImage?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract histogram features at multiple scales
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            int gridSize = 8;
            int cellHeight = image.Height / gridSize;
            int cellWidth = image.Width / gridSize;
            
            for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                {
                    OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                        x * cellWidth,
                        y * cellHeight,
                        cellWidth,
                        cellHeight
                    );
                    
                    using (Mat cell = image.SubMat(roi))
                    {
                        Cv2.MeanStdDev(cell, out Scalar mean, out Scalar stddev);
                        features.Add((float)mean.Val0 / 255.0f);
                        features.Add((float)stddev.Val0 / 255.0f);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract gradient-based features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractGradientFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                Mat gradX = new Mat();
                Mat gradY = new Mat();
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradX, MatType.CV_32F, 1, 0, ksize: 3);
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradY, MatType.CV_32F, 0, 1, ksize: 3);
                
                Mat magnitude = new Mat();
                Mat angle = new Mat();
                Cv2.CartToPolar(gradX, gradY, magnitude, angle, angleInDegrees: true);
                
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = magnitude.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = magnitude.Width / gridSize;
                int numOrientations = 8;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        
                        using (Mat magCell = magnitude.SubMat(roi))
                        using (Mat angCell = angle.SubMat(roi))
                        {
                            float[] histogram = new float[numOrientations];
                            
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    float mag = magCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    float ang = angCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    int bin = (int)((ang / 360.0f) * numOrientations) % numOrientations;
                                    histogram[bin] += mag;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            float sum = histogram.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < numOrientations; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(histogram[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                gradX.Dispose();
                gradY.Dispose();
                magnitude.Dispose();
                angle.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Gradient feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract LBP features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractLBPFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                Mat lbp = new Mat(image.Size(), MatType.CV_8UC1);
                
                for (int y = 1; y < image.Height - 1; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 1; x < image.Width - 1; x++)
                    {
                        byte center = image.Get<byte>(y, x);
                        byte code = 0;
                        
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 1;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x) >= center) code |= 2;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 4;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x + 1) >= center) code |= 8;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 16;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x) >= center) code |= 32;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 64;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x - 1) >= center) code |= 128;
                        
                        lbp.Set(y, x, code);
                    }
                }
                
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = lbp.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = lbp.Width / gridSize;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        using (Mat cell = lbp.SubMat(roi))
                        {
                            float[] hist = new float[8];
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    byte val = cell.Get<byte>(r, c);
                                    int bin = val / 32;
                                    hist[bin]++;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            float sum = hist.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(hist[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                lbp.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ LBP feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Normalize vector to unit length
        /// </summary>
        private float[] NormalizeVector(float[] vector)
        {
            float norm = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                norm += vector[i] * vector[i];
            }
            norm = Mathf.Sqrt(norm);
            
            if (norm < 1e-6f) return vector;
            
            float[] normalized = new float[vector.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                normalized[i] = vector[i] / norm;
            }
            return normalized;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embedding for a single image using OpenCV DNN
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateEmbeddingForImage(string imagePath)
        {
            Mat image = null;
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat blob = null;
            Mat output = null;

            try
            {
                // Load image
                image = Cv2.ImRead(imagePath, ImreadModes.Color);
                if (image.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Failed to load image: {imagePath}");
                    return null;
                }

                // Convert to RGB (OpenCV loads as BGR)
                rgbImage = new Mat();
                Cv2.CvtColor(image, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2RGB);

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Create blob from image (normalized to [0, 1])
                // OpenCV DNN expects: (batch, channels, height, width)
                blob = CvDnn.BlobFromImage(
                    resized,
                    1.0 / 255.0,  // scale factor - Normalize to [0, 1]
                    new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE),
                    new Scalar(0, 0, 0),  // mean
                    false,  // swapRB - We already converted to RGB
                    false   // crop
                );

                // Run inference
                _dnnModel.SetInput(blob);
                output = _dnnModel.Forward();

                // Extract embedding as float array
                int embeddingSize = (int)output.Total();
                float[] embedding = new float[embeddingSize];
                
                // Get indexer for safe access
                var indexer = output.GetGenericIndexer<float>();
                
                // Copy data from Mat to array
                for (int i = 0; i < embeddingSize; i++)
                {
                    embedding[i] = indexer[0, i];
                }

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error processing image {imagePath}: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                image?.Dispose();
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                blob?.Dispose();
                output?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Save embeddings to JSON file
        /// </summary>
        private void SaveEmbeddingsToFile(Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> embeddings)
        {
            string outputPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsOutputPath);
            
            // Convert to serializable format
            PreprocessorEmbeddingsData data = new PreprocessorEmbeddingsData
            {
                embeddings = new List<PersonEmbeddings>()
            };

            foreach (var kvp in embeddings)
            {
                PersonEmbeddings personData = new PersonEmbeddings
                {
                    name = kvp.Key,
                    embeddings = new List<EmbeddingVector>()
                };

                foreach (float[] embedding in kvp.Value)
                {
                    personData.embeddings.Add(new EmbeddingVector { values = embedding });
                }

                data.embeddings.Add(personData);
            }

            // Serialize to JSON
            string json = JsonUtility.ToJson(data, prettyPrint: true);
            File.WriteAllText(outputPath, json);

            Debug.Log($"💾 Embeddings saved to: {outputPath}");
            Debug.Log($"📦 File size: {new FileInfo(outputPath).Length / 1024.0:F2} KB");
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            _dnnModel?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    // Serializable classes for JSON export
    [System.Serializable]
    public class PreprocessorEmbeddingsData
    {
        public List<PersonEmbeddings> embeddings;
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public class PersonEmbeddings
    {
        public string name;
        public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        public List<EmbeddingVector> opencvFeatures; // NEW: OpenCV-compatible features
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public class EmbeddingVector
    {
        public float[] values;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using OpenCvSharp;
using OpenCvSharp.Dnn;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using UnityEditor;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Editor-only tool to preprocess training images and generate embeddings using the large ArcFace model.
    /// This runs ONLY in the Unity Editor on your PC, not on Magic Leap 2.
    /// Uses OpenCV DNN module instead of Barracuda for better compatibility.
    /// The generated embeddings are small and can be loaded on the device.
    /// </summary>
    public class FaceEmbeddingPreprocessor : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Editor-Only Settings (PC)")]
        [Tooltip("Path to ArcFace ONNX model (in Assets folder)")]
        public string onnxModelPath = "Models/arcface.onnx";
        
        [Tooltip("Path to training data folder (relative to StreamingAssets)")]
        public string trainingDataFolder = "Faces";
        
        [Tooltip("Where to save the generated embeddings (relative to StreamingAssets)")]
        public string embeddingsOutputPath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Header("Processing Status")]
        public bool isProcessing = false;
        public int totalImagesProcessed = 0;
        public string statusMessage = "Ready to process";
        
        private const int MODEL_INPUT_SIZE = 112; // ArcFace input size
        private Net _dnnModel;

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embeddings for all training images (call from Inspector context menu)
        /// </summary>
        [ContextMenu("Generate Embeddings (Editor Only)")]
        public void GenerateEmbeddings()
        {
            if (Application.isPlaying)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ This tool should only be used in Edit mode, not Play mode!");
                return;
            }

            Debug.Log("🚀 Starting embedding generation on PC...");
            isProcessing = true;
            totalImagesProcessed = 0;

            try
            {
                // Load the large ArcFace model using OpenCV DNN
                string modelFullPath = Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, onnxModelPath);
                
                if (!File.Exists(modelFullPath))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Model file not found: {modelFullPath}");
                    return;
                }

                Debug.Log($"📦 Loading model from: {modelFullPath}");
                _dnnModel = Net.ReadNetFromONNX(modelFullPath);
                
                if (_dnnModel == null || _dnnModel.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to load ONNX model with OpenCV DNN");
                    return;
                }

                Debug.Log("✅ Large model loaded successfully with OpenCV DNN!");

                // Process all training images
                string trainingDataPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, trainingDataFolder);
                
                if (!Directory.Exists(trainingDataPath))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Training data folder not found: {trainingDataPath}");
                    return;
                }

                // Dictionary to hold embeddings for each person
                Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> allEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();

                // Get all person folders
                string[] personFolders = Directory.GetDirectories(trainingDataPath);
                Debug.Log($"📂 Found {personFolders.Length} people to process");

                foreach (string personFolder in personFolders)
                {
                    string personName = Path.GetFileName(personFolder);
                    
                    if (personName == "Unknown" || personName.StartsWith("."))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    Debug.Log($"📸 Processing {personName}...");
                    statusMessage = $"Processing {personName}...";

                    // Get all images for this person
                    string[] imageExtensions = { "*.jpg", "*.jpeg", "*.png", "*.bmp" };
                    List<string> imageFiles = new List<string>();
                    
                    foreach (string extension in imageExtensions)
                    {
                        imageFiles.AddRange(Directory.GetFiles(personFolder, extension, SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly));
                    }

                    if (imageFiles.Count == 0)
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ No images found for {personName}");
                        continue;
                    }

                    List<float[]> personEmbeddings = new List<float[]>();
                    List<float[]> personOpenCVFeatures = new List<float[]>();

                    // Process each image
                    foreach (string imagePath in imageFiles)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            // Generate ArcFace embedding
                            float[] embedding = GenerateEmbeddingForImage(imagePath);
                            
                            // ALSO generate OpenCV-compatible features from same image
                            float[] opencvFeatures = GenerateOpenCVFeaturesForImage(imagePath);
                            
                            if (embedding != null && opencvFeatures != null)
                            {
                                personEmbeddings.Add(embedding);
                                personOpenCVFeatures.Add(opencvFeatures);
                                totalImagesProcessed++;
                            }
                        }
                        catch (System.Exception e)
                        {
                            Debug.LogError($"❌ Error processing {imagePath}: {e.Message}");
                        }
                    }

                    if (personEmbeddings.Count > 0)
                    {
                        allEmbeddings[personName] = personEmbeddings;
                        allOpenCVFeatures[personName] = personOpenCVFeatures;
                        Debug.Log($"✅ Generated {personEmbeddings.Count} ArcFace embeddings + OpenCV features for {personName}");
                    }
                }

                // Save embeddings to file
                SaveEmbeddingsToFile(allEmbeddings, allOpenCVFeatures);

                Debug.Log($"🎉 SUCCESS! Processed {totalImagesProcessed} images for {allEmbeddings.Count} people!");
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Fatal error during embedding generation: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                _dnnModel?.Dispose();
                isProcessing = false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate OpenCV-compatible features for a single image (same as device will use)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateOpenCVFeaturesForImage(string imagePath)
        {
            Mat image = null;
            Mat grayImage = null;
            
            try
            {
                // Load image
                image = Cv2.ImRead(imagePath, ImreadModes.Color);
                if (image.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Failed to load image: {imagePath}");
                    return null;
                }

                // Convert to grayscale
                grayImage = new Mat();
                Cv2.CvtColor(image, grayImage, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);

                // Resize to standard size (same as device)
                Mat resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(grayImage, resized, new Size(112, 112), interpolation: InterpolationFlags.Area);
                
                // Apply CLAHE (same as device)
                Mat enhanced = new Mat();
                using (var clahe = Cv2.CreateCLAHE(clipLimit: 2.0, tileGridSize: new Size(8, 8)))
                {
                    clahe.Apply(resized, enhanced);
                }
                
                // Extract multi-scale features (SAME as EnhancedOpenCVRecognizer)
                List<float> features = new List<float>();
                
                // 1. Multi-scale histogram features
                features.AddRange(ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(enhanced));
                
                // 2. Gradient features
                features.AddRange(ExtractGradientFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // 3. LBP features
                features.AddRange(ExtractLBPFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // Cleanup
                resized.Dispose();
                enhanced.Dispose();
                
                // Normalize
                float[] featureArray = features.ToArray();
                return NormalizeVector(featureArray);
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error extracting OpenCV features from {imagePath}: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                image?.Dispose();
                grayImage?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract histogram features at multiple scales
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            int gridSize = 8;
            int cellHeight = image.Height / gridSize;
            int cellWidth = image.Width / gridSize;
            
            for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                {
                    OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                        x * cellWidth,
                        y * cellHeight,
                        cellWidth,
                        cellHeight
                    );
                    
                    using (Mat cell = image.SubMat(roi))
                    {
                        Cv2.MeanStdDev(cell, out Scalar mean, out Scalar stddev);
                        features.Add((float)mean.Val0 / 255.0f);
                        features.Add((float)stddev.Val0 / 255.0f);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract gradient-based features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractGradientFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                Mat gradX = new Mat();
                Mat gradY = new Mat();
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradX, MatType.CV_32F, 1, 0, ksize: 3);
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradY, MatType.CV_32F, 0, 1, ksize: 3);
                
                Mat magnitude = new Mat();
                Mat angle = new Mat();
                Cv2.CartToPolar(gradX, gradY, magnitude, angle, angleInDegrees: true);
                
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = magnitude.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = magnitude.Width / gridSize;
                int numOrientations = 8;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        
                        using (Mat magCell = magnitude.SubMat(roi))
                        using (Mat angCell = angle.SubMat(roi))
                        {
                            float[] histogram = new float[numOrientations];
                            
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    float mag = magCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    float ang = angCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    int bin = (int)((ang / 360.0f) * numOrientations) % numOrientations;
                                    histogram[bin] += mag;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            float sum = histogram.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < numOrientations; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(histogram[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                gradX.Dispose();
                gradY.Dispose();
                magnitude.Dispose();
                angle.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Gradient feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract LBP features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractLBPFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                Mat lbp = new Mat(image.Size(), MatType.CV_8UC1);
                
                for (int y = 1; y < image.Height - 1; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 1; x < image.Width - 1; x++)
                    {
                        byte center = image.Get<byte>(y, x);
                        byte code = 0;
                        
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 1;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x) >= center) code |= 2;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 4;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x + 1) >= center) code |= 8;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 16;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x) >= center) code |= 32;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 64;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x - 1) >= center) code |= 128;
                        
                        lbp.Set(y, x, code);
                    }
                }
                
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = lbp.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = lbp.Width / gridSize;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        using (Mat cell = lbp.SubMat(roi))
                        {
                            float[] hist = new float[8];
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    byte val = cell.Get<byte>(r, c);
                                    int bin = val / 32;
                                    hist[bin]++;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            float sum = hist.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(hist[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                lbp.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ LBP feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Normalize vector to unit length
        /// </summary>
        private float[] NormalizeVector(float[] vector)
        {
            float norm = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                norm += vector[i] * vector[i];
            }
            norm = Mathf.Sqrt(norm);
            
            if (norm < 1e-6f) return vector;
            
            float[] normalized = new float[vector.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                normalized[i] = vector[i] / norm;
            }
            return normalized;
        }

                PersonEmbeddings personData = new PersonEmbeddings
                {

                    embeddings = new List<EmbeddingVector>()
                };

                    personData.embeddings.Add(new EmbeddingVector { values = embedding });
                }

                data.embeddings.Add(personData);
            }

            // Serialize to JSON
            string json = JsonUtility.ToJson(data, prettyPrint: true);
            File.WriteAllText(outputPath, json);

            Debug.Log($"💾 Embeddings saved to: {outputPath}");
            Debug.Log($"📦 File size: {new FileInfo(outputPath).Length / 1024.0:F2} KB");
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            _dnnModel?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    // Serializable classes for JSON export
    [System.Serializable]
    public class PreprocessorEmbeddingsData
    {

    [System.Serializable]
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace Recogneyes

    /// <summary>
    /// Editor-only tool to preprocess training images and generate embeddings using the large ArcFace model.
    /// This runs ONLY in the Unity Editor on your PC, not on Magic Leap 2.
    /// Uses OpenCV DNN module instead of Barracuda for better compatibility.

    public class FaceEmbeddingPreprocessor : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Editor-Only Settings (PC)")]
        [Tooltip("Path to ArcFace ONNX model (in Assets folder)")]

        [Tooltip("Path to training data folder (relative to StreamingAssets)")]
        public string trainingDataFolder = "Faces";
        
        [Tooltip("Where to save the generated embeddings (relative to StreamingAssets)")]
        public string embeddingsOutputPath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Header("Processing Status")]

        private const int MODEL_INPUT_SIZE = 112; // ArcFace input size

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embeddings for all training images (call from Inspector context menu)
        /// </summary>
        [ContextMenu("Generate Embeddings (Editor Only)")]
        public void GenerateEmbeddings()
        {
            if (Application.isPlaying)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ This tool should only be used in Edit mode, not Play mode!");
                return;
            }

            Debug.Log("🚀 Starting embedding generation on PC...");
            isProcessing = true;
            totalImagesProcessed = 0;

            try
            {
                // Load the large ArcFace model using OpenCV DNN
                string modelFullPath = Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, onnxModelPath);
                
                if (!File.Exists(modelFullPath))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Model file not found: {modelFullPath}");
                    return;
                }

                Debug.Log($"📦 Loading model from: {modelFullPath}");
                _dnnModel = Net.ReadNetFromONNX(modelFullPath);
                
                if (_dnnModel == null || _dnnModel.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to load ONNX model with OpenCV DNN");
                    return;
                }

                Debug.Log("✅ Large model loaded successfully with OpenCV DNN!");

                // Process all training images
                string trainingDataPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, trainingDataFolder);
                
                if (!Directory.Exists(trainingDataPath))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Training data folder not found: {trainingDataPath}");
                    return;
                }

                // Dictionary to hold embeddings for each person
                Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> allEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();

                // Get all person folders
                string[] personFolders = Directory.GetDirectories(trainingDataPath);
                Debug.Log($"📂 Found {personFolders.Length} people to process");

                foreach (string personFolder in personFolders)
                {
                    string personName = Path.GetFileName(personFolder);
                    
                    if (personName == "Unknown" || personName.StartsWith("."))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    Debug.Log($"📸 Processing {personName}...");
                    statusMessage = $"Processing {personName}...";

                    // Get all images for this person
                    string[] imageExtensions = { "*.jpg", "*.jpeg", "*.png", "*.bmp" };
                    List<string> imageFiles = new List<string>();
                    
                    foreach (string extension in imageExtensions)
                    {
                        imageFiles.AddRange(Directory.GetFiles(personFolder, extension, SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly));
                    }

                    if (imageFiles.Count == 0)
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ No images found for {personName}");
                        continue;
                    }

                    List<float[]> personEmbeddings = new List<float[]>();
                    List<float[]> personOpenCVFeatures = new List<float[]>();

                    // Process each image
                    foreach (string imagePath in imageFiles)
                    {

                        {

                            float[] embedding = GenerateEmbeddingForImage(imagePath);

                            float[] opencvFeatures = GenerateOpenCVFeaturesForImage(imagePath);
                            
                            if (embedding != null && opencvFeatures != null)
                            {
                                personEmbeddings.Add(embedding);
                                personOpenCVFeatures.Add(opencvFeatures);
                                totalImagesProcessed++;
                            }

                        }

                        allOpenCVFeatures[personName] = personOpenCVFeatures;

                SaveEmbeddingsToFile(allEmbeddings, allOpenCVFeatures);

            }

            {

            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                _dnnModel?.Dispose();
                isProcessing = false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate OpenCV-compatible features for a single image (same as device will use)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateOpenCVFeaturesForImage(string imagePath)
        {
            Mat image = null;
            Mat grayImage = null;
            
            try
            {
                // Load image
                image = Cv2.ImRead(imagePath, ImreadModes.Color);
                if (image.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Failed to load image: {imagePath}");
                    return null;
                }

                // Convert to grayscale
                grayImage = new Mat();
                Cv2.CvtColor(image, grayImage, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);

                // Resize to standard size (same as device)
                Mat resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(grayImage, resized, new Size(112, 112), interpolation: InterpolationFlags.Area);
                
                // Apply CLAHE (same as device)
                Mat enhanced = new Mat();
                using (var clahe = Cv2.CreateCLAHE(clipLimit: 2.0, tileGridSize: new Size(8, 8)))
                {
                    clahe.Apply(resized, enhanced);
                }
                
                // Extract multi-scale features (SAME as EnhancedOpenCVRecognizer)
                List<float> features = new List<float>();
                
                // 1. Multi-scale histogram features
                features.AddRange(ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(enhanced));
                
                // 2. Gradient features
                features.AddRange(ExtractGradientFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // 3. LBP features
                features.AddRange(ExtractLBPFeatures(enhanced));
                
                // Cleanup
                resized.Dispose();
                enhanced.Dispose();
                
                // Normalize
                float[] featureArray = features.ToArray();
                return NormalizeVector(featureArray);
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error extracting OpenCV features from {imagePath}: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                image?.Dispose();
                grayImage?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract histogram features at multiple scales
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractMultiScaleHistogram(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            int gridSize = 8;
            int cellHeight = image.Height / gridSize;
            int cellWidth = image.Width / gridSize;
            
            for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                {
                    OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                        x * cellWidth,
                        y * cellHeight,
                        cellWidth,
                        cellHeight
                    );
                    
                    using (Mat cell = image.SubMat(roi))
                    {
                        Cv2.MeanStdDev(cell, out Scalar mean, out Scalar stddev);
                        features.Add((float)mean.Val0 / 255.0f);
                        features.Add((float)stddev.Val0 / 255.0f);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract gradient-based features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractGradientFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                Mat gradX = new Mat();
                Mat gradY = new Mat();
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradX, MatType.CV_32F, 1, 0, ksize: 3);
                Cv2.Sobel(image, gradY, MatType.CV_32F, 0, 1, ksize: 3);
                
                Mat magnitude = new Mat();
                Mat angle = new Mat();
                Cv2.CartToPolar(gradX, gradY, magnitude, angle, angleInDegrees: true);
                
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = magnitude.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = magnitude.Width / gridSize;
                int numOrientations = 8;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        
                        using (Mat magCell = magnitude.SubMat(roi))
                        using (Mat angCell = angle.SubMat(roi))
                        {
                            float[] histogram = new float[numOrientations];
                            
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    float mag = magCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    float ang = angCell.Get<float>(r, c);
                                    int bin = (int)((ang / 360.0f) * numOrientations) % numOrientations;
                                    histogram[bin] += mag;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            float sum = histogram.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < numOrientations; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(histogram[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                gradX.Dispose();
                gradY.Dispose();
                magnitude.Dispose();
                angle.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Gradient feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract LBP features
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractLBPFeatures(Mat image)
        {
            List<float> features = new List<float>();
            
            try
            {
                Mat lbp = new Mat(image.Size(), MatType.CV_8UC1);
                
                for (int y = 1; y < image.Height - 1; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 1; x < image.Width - 1; x++)
                    {
                        byte center = image.Get<byte>(y, x);
                        byte code = 0;
                        
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 1;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x) >= center) code |= 2;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y - 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 4;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x + 1) >= center) code |= 8;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x + 1) >= center) code |= 16;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x) >= center) code |= 32;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y + 1, x - 1) >= center) code |= 64;
                        if (image.Get<byte>(y, x - 1) >= center) code |= 128;
                        
                        lbp.Set(y, x, code);
                    }
                }
                
                int gridSize = 8;
                int cellHeight = lbp.Height / gridSize;
                int cellWidth = lbp.Width / gridSize;
                
                for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++)
                    {
                        OpenCvSharp.Rect roi = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(x * cellWidth, y * cellHeight, cellWidth, cellHeight);
                        using (Mat cell = lbp.SubMat(roi))
                        {
                            float[] hist = new float[8];
                            for (int r = 0; r < cellHeight; r++)
                            {
                                for (int c = 0; c < cellWidth; c++)
                                {
                                    byte val = cell.Get<byte>(r, c);
                                    int bin = val / 32;
                                    hist[bin]++;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            float sum = hist.Sum() + 1e-6f;
                            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                            {
                                features.Add(hist[i] / sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                lbp.Dispose();
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ LBP feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) features.Add(0);
            }
            
            return features.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Normalize vector to unit length
        /// </summary>
        private float[] NormalizeVector(float[] vector)
        {
            float norm = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                norm += vector[i] * vector[i];
            }
            norm = Mathf.Sqrt(norm);
            
            if (norm < 1e-6f) return vector;
            
            float[] normalized = new float[vector.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < vector.Length; i++)
            {
                normalized[i] = vector[i] / norm;
            }
            return normalized;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embedding for a single image using OpenCV DNN
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateEmbeddingForImage(string imagePath)
        {
            Mat image = null;
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat blob = null;
            Mat output = null;

            try
            {
                // Load image
                image = Cv2.ImRead(imagePath, ImreadModes.Color);
                if (image.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Failed to load image: {imagePath}");
                    return null;
                }

                // Convert to RGB (OpenCV loads as BGR)
                rgbImage = new Mat();
                Cv2.CvtColor(image, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2RGB);

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Create blob from image (normalized to [0, 1])
                // OpenCV DNN expects: (batch, channels, height, width)
                blob = CvDnn.BlobFromImage(
                    resized,
                    1.0 / 255.0,  // scale factor - Normalize to [0, 1]
                    new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE),
                    new Scalar(0, 0, 0),  // mean
                    false,  // swapRB - We already converted to RGB
                    false   // crop
                );

                // Run inference
                _dnnModel.SetInput(blob);
                output = _dnnModel.Forward();

                // Extract embedding as float array
                int embeddingSize = (int)output.Total();
                float[] embedding = new float[embeddingSize];
                
                // Get indexer for safe access
                var indexer = output.GetGenericIndexer<float>();
                
                // Copy data from Mat to array
                for (int i = 0; i < embeddingSize; i++)
                {
                    embedding[i] = indexer[0, i];
                }

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error processing image {imagePath}: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                image?.Dispose();
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                blob?.Dispose();
                output?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Save embeddings to JSON file (both ArcFace and OpenCV features)
        /// </summary>
        private void SaveEmbeddingsToFile(Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> embeddings, Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> opencvFeatures)
        {
            string outputPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsOutputPath);
            
            // Convert to serializable format
            PreprocessorEmbeddingsData data = new PreprocessorEmbeddingsData
            {
                embeddings = new List<PersonEmbeddings>()
            };

            foreach (var kvp in embeddings)
            {
                PersonEmbeddings personData = new PersonEmbeddings
                {
                    name = kvp.Key,
                    embeddings = new List<EmbeddingVector>(),
                    opencvFeatures = new List<EmbeddingVector>()
                };

                // Add ArcFace embeddings
                foreach (float[] embedding in kvp.Value)
                {
                    personData.embeddings.Add(new EmbeddingVector { values = embedding });
                }

                // Add OpenCV features
                if (opencvFeatures.ContainsKey(kvp.Key))
                {
                    foreach (float[] opencvFeat in opencvFeatures[kvp.Key])
                    {
                        personData.opencvFeatures.Add(new EmbeddingVector { values = opencvFeat });
                    }
                }

                data.embeddings.Add(personData);
            }

            // Serialize to JSON
            string json = JsonUtility.ToJson(data, prettyPrint: true);
            File.WriteAllText(outputPath, json);

            Debug.Log($"💾 Embeddings saved to: {outputPath}");
            Debug.Log($"📦 File size: {new FileInfo(outputPath).Length / 1024.0:F2} KB");
            Debug.Log($"✅ Saved both ArcFace embeddings AND OpenCV-compatible features!");
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            _dnnModel?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    // Serializable classes for JSON export
    [System.Serializable]
    public class PreprocessorEmbeddingsData
    {
        public List<PersonEmbeddings> embeddings;
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public class PersonEmbeddings
    {
        public string name;
        public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        public List<EmbeddingVector> opencvFeatures; // NEW: OpenCV-compatible features
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public class EmbeddingVector
    {
        public float[] values;
    }
}
```
